input: Freeze a batch of homemade stock this week

gold.taskTitle: Freeze a Batch of Homemade Stock This Week
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to prepare and freeze a batch of homemade stock sometime this week.

questions.title: What type of stock are you making?
questions.description: Identify the stock type: chicken, beef, vegetable, fish, bone broth, etc.

questions.title: Are you making the stock from scratch or using leftovers?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is starting fresh with raw ingredients or using leftover bones, vegetable scraps, or carcasses already on hand.

questions.title: How large a batch are you planning to make?
questions.description: Clarify the intended volume, such as a single pot, a specific number of quarts, or a rough quantity.

questions.title: What containers will you freeze the stock in?
questions.description: Establish what the user plans to use: mason jars, zip-lock bags, ice cube trays, deli containers, etc.

questions.title: Which specific day this week do you plan to cook it?
questions.description: Pin down a target cooking day to help structure a realistic schedule.

questions.title: Do you need to shop for any ingredients first?
questions.description: Find out whether the user already has all ingredients or needs a grocery run before cooking.

questions.title: How do you plan to portion the stock before freezing?
questions.description: Understand the intended serving sizes for freezing, such as 1-cup, 2-cup, or full-quart portions, based on typical future use.
